2609.04021.title: FLY-EVAL++: An Evidence-Driven Evaluation Protocol for Safety-Constrained Flight Prediction with Large Language Models
2609.04021.paper_summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) in safety-critical, physics-governed environments requires more than accuracy-based metrics, because predictions that are numerically close to the ground truth can still violate operational constraints, combine fields in physically inconsistent ways, or fail to produce usable structured outputs. Existing evaluation protocols do not measure these failure modes reliably. We propose FLY-EVAL++, an evidence-driven evaluation protocol that combines deterministic verification of protocol compliance, physical feasibility, and safety constraints with fixed rubric-guided aggregation into interpretable multi-dimensional scores. We instantiate FLY-EVAL++ for Flight Trajectory and Attitude Prediction (FTAP) by extending the PilotBench setting with history-conditioned and multi-step prediction tasks. Across 66 LLMs, safety compliance is the most discriminative dimension of model behavior: models with comparable predictive performance differ by more than 28 points in safety score, and we observe recurrent failures including safety violations under physically plausible predictions and instability in multi-step rollouts. These results show that evaluation in safety-critical domains should measure constraint satisfaction and structured validity explicitly rather than rely on accuracy-centric reporting alone.
2609.04021.paper_summary_zh: 評估在安全關鍵、物理約束環境中的大型語言模型（LLMs）需要的不僅僅是基於準確性的指標，因為數值上接近真實值的預測仍然可能違反操作約束、以物理不一致的方式結合領域，或無法產生可用的結構化輸出。現有的評估協議無法可靠地測量這些失敗模式。我們提出了 FLY-EVAL++，這是一種基於證據的評估協議，結合了對協議遵循性、物理可行性和安全約束的確定性驗證，以及固定評分標準指導的可解釋多維得分的聚合。我們通過擴展 PilotBench 設定，將歷史條件和多步預測任務納入，為飛行軌跡和姿態預測（FTAP）實現 FLY-EVAL++。在 66 個 LLM 中，安全合規性是模型行為中最具區分性的維度：具有可比預測性能的模型在安全得分上相差超過 28 分，我們觀察到反覆出現的失敗，包括在物理上合理的預測下的安全違規和多步展開中的不穩定性。這些結果表明，在安全關鍵領域的評估應明確測量約束滿足和結構有效性，而不僅僅依賴於以準確性為中心的報告。
